examples.chinese: 我有一個英國朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge Yīngguó péngyǒu.
examples.english: I have a British friend.

examples.chinese: 我的女朋友很喜歡喝珍珠奶茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de nǚ péngyǒu hěn xǐhuān hē zhēnzhū nǎichá.
examples.english: My girlfriend likes bubble milk tea very much.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友常常一起去吃冰淇淋。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu chángcháng yìqǐ qù chī bīngqílín.
examples.english: My friends and I often go have ice cream together.

examples.chinese: 我想去朋友家玩，可是沒有空。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù péngyǒu jiā wán, kěshì méi yǒukòng.
examples.english: I would like to go to my friend’s place, but I don’t have time.

examples.chinese: 他常常幫朋友，是一個好人。
examples.pinyin: Tā chángcháng bāng péngyǒu, shì yí ge hǎo rén.
examples.english: He helps his friends often. He is a nice guy.

examples.chinese: 今天我去朋友家玩得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ qù péngyǒu jiā wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: I had fun at my friend’s place today.

examples.chinese: 我朋友說這家餐廳的咖啡很好喝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu shuō zhè jiā cāntīng de kāfēi hěn hǎohē.
examples.english: My friend said this restaurant’s coffee is good.

examples.chinese: 我男朋友不太喜歡說話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nán péngyǒu bú tài xǐhuān shuōhuà.
examples.english: My boyfriend does not like to talk very much.

examples.chinese: 後天是我朋友的生日，我想送他一個大蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Hòutiān shì wǒ péngyǒu de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge dà dàngāo.
examples.english: The day after tomorrow is my friend’s birthday; I want to give him a big cake.

examples.chinese: 後天是我朋友的生日，我想要送他一個大蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Hòutiān shì wǒ péngyǒu de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng yào sòng tā yí ge dà dàngāo.
examples.english: The day after tomorrow is my friend's birthday; I want to give him a big cake.

examples.chinese: 我有幾個臺灣朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu jǐ ge Táiwān péngyǒu.
examples.english: I have a few Taiwanese friends.

examples.chinese: 我有幾個台灣朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu jǐ ge Táiwān péngyǒu.
examples.english: I have several Taiwanese friends.

examples.chinese: 我後天要到這家飯店去看朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hòutiān yào dào zhè jiā fàndiàn qù kàn péngyǒu.
examples.english: The day after tomorrow I am going to this hotel to see a friend.

examples.chinese: 我今天想找朋友去吃飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān xiǎng zhǎo péngyǒu qù chīfàn.
examples.english: Today I want to find a friend to go eat.

examples.chinese: 我的朋友在那家旅館前面等我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyǒu zài nà jiā lǚguǎn qiánmiàn děng wǒ.
examples.english: My friend is waiting for me in front of that hotel.

examples.chinese: 他最近常常跟朋友一起玩。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn chángcháng gēn péngyǒu yīqǐ wán.
examples.english: He often hangs out with friends recently.

examples.chinese: 我常常跟日本朋友練習說日文。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng gēn Rìběn péngyǒu liànxí shuō Rìwén.
examples.english: I often practice speaking Japanese with Japanese friends.

examples.chinese: 每個人都需要朋友。我累了，需要回家休息。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu xūyào péngyǒu. Wǒ lèi le, xūyào huí jiā xiūxi.
examples.english: Everyone needs friends. I'm tired and need to go home to rest.

examples.chinese: 我昨天跟朋友說了很多話，我們都很開心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān gēn péngyou shuō le hěn duō huà, wǒmen dōu hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Yesterday I said a lot to my friend, and we were both very happy.

examples.chinese: 這是我朋友送我的生日卡片。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ péngyou sòng wǒ de shēngrì kǎpiàn.
examples.english: This is the birthday card my friend gave me.

examples.chinese: A:昨天你去運動了嗎 ？ B:我沒去運動，我去朋友家玩。
examples.pinyin: A: Zuótiān nǐ qù yùndòng le ma? B: Wǒ méi qù yùndòng, wǒ qù péngyou jiā wán.
examples.english: A: Did you go exercise yesterday? B: I didn't go exercise; I went to a friend's house to have fun.

examples.chinese: 他打算坐捷運去跟朋友見面。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎsuàn zuò jiéyùn qù gēn péngyǒu jiànmiàn.
examples.english: He plans to take the MRT to meet a friend.

examples.chinese: 週末我有空，要約朋友一起去玩。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ yǒu kòng, yào yuē péngyǒu yìqǐ qù wán.
examples.english: I'm free this weekend; I want to make an appointment with friends to go out and have fun together.

examples.chinese: 我有一些台灣朋友，所以說中文的機會很多。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yìxiē Táiwān péngyǒu, suǒyǐ shuō Zhōngwén de jīhuì hěn duō.
examples.english: I have some Taiwanese friends, so I have many chances to speak Chinese.

examples.chinese: 我常常用中文給台灣朋友寫信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng yòng Zhōngwén gěi Táiwān péngyǒu xiě xìn.
examples.english: I often write letters to Taiwanese friends in Chinese.

examples.chinese: 下班以後，她常跟朋友一起去跑步。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, tā cháng gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ qù pǎobù.
examples.english: After getting off work, she often goes running with friends.

examples.chinese: 他今天給我介紹了一個新朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān gěi wǒ jièshào le yí ge xīn péngyou.
examples.english: Today he introduced a new friend to me.

examples.chinese: 我在台灣的生活不錯，很喜歡這裡，也有很多好朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài Táiwān de shēnghuó búcuò, hěn xǐhuan zhèlǐ, yě yǒu hěn duō hǎo péngyou.
examples.english: My life in Taiwan is good; I like it here a lot, and I also have many good friends.

examples.chinese: 我覺得打球比跑步有意思，我常跟朋友一起打籃球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde dǎqiú bǐ pǎobù yǒu yìsi, wǒ cháng gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: I think playing ball is more interesting than running; I often play basketball with friends.

examples.chinese: 來台灣以後，我認識了很多國家的新朋友。
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān yǐhòu, wǒ rènshi le hěn duō guójiā de xīn péngyǒu.
examples.english: After coming to Taiwan, I have met many new friends from many countries.

examples.chinese: 他手裡拿著禮物，在學校門口等著女朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā shǒu lǐ názhe lǐwù, zài xuéxiào ménkǒu děngzhe nǚpéngyǒu.
examples.english: He is holding a gift in his hand and is waiting for his girlfriend at the school entrance.

examples.chinese: 明天我要跟朋友去參加跨年活動，我還沒跟父母講這件事。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào gēn péngyǒu qù cānjiā kuànián huódòng, wǒ hái méi gēn fùmǔ jiǎng zhè jiàn shì.
examples.english: Tomorrow I'm going with friends to attend a New Year's Eve event; I still haven't talked to my parents about this.

examples.chinese: 我記得去年跟幾個朋友一起打過籃球，真好玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde qùnián gēn jǐ gè péngyǒu yīqǐ dǎguo lánqiú, zhēn hǎowán.
examples.english: I remember last year I played basketball with a few friends; it was really fun.

examples.chinese: 我們從小學到大學都是同學，也是很好的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen cóng xiǎoxué dào dàxué dōu shì tóngxué, yě shì hěn hǎo de péngyǒu.
examples.english: From elementary school to university, we have always been classmates and also very good friends.

examples.chinese: 我跟朋友這次去英國玩了八天七夜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyou zhè cì qù Yīngguó wán le bā tiān qī yè.
examples.english: This time I went to England with a friend and played for eight days and seven nights.

examples.chinese: 出國學習語言可以了解外國的文化，再說，也可以認識外國朋友，非常值得。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó xuéxí yǔyán kěyǐ liǎojiě wàiguó de wénhuà, zàishuō, yě kěyǐ rènshi wàiguó péngyou, fēicháng zhídé.
examples.english: Going abroad to study a language can help you understand foreign cultures; moreover, you can also meet foreign friends—it's very worthwhile.

examples.chinese: 一般人都喜歡跟性格溫柔、樂觀的人交朋友。
examples.pinyin: Yībān rén dōu xǐhuān gēn xìnggé wēnróu, lèguān de rén jiāo péngyǒu.
examples.english: Most people like to make friends with people who have a gentle and optimistic personality.

examples.chinese: 對我來說，冬天的樂趣就是戴著厚厚的手套，和朋友玩雪球。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, dōngtiān de lèqù jiùshì dài zhe hòu hòu de shǒutào, hé péngyǒu wán xuěqiú.
examples.english: For me, the joy of winter is wearing thick gloves and playing snowballs with friends.

examples.chinese: 昨天小康碰到一位好久不見的老朋友，他們聊天聊到很晚才回家。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān Xiǎo Kāng pèng dào yí wèi hǎojiǔ bú jiàn de lǎo péngyǒu, tāmen liáotiān liáo dào hěn wǎn cái huí jiā.
examples.english: Yesterday, Xiao Kang bumped into an old friend he hadn't seen for a long time; they chatted until very late before going home.

examples.chinese: 包小姐的眼光很好，一看就知道那件黃色外套的品質最好。妹妹：我希望將來找個又聰明又有錢 ，而且很體貼我的男朋友。 姊姊：妳的眼光太高了，恐怕找不到。
examples.pinyin: Bāo xiǎojiě de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, yí kàn jiù zhīdào nà jiàn huángsè wàitào de pǐnzhí zuì hǎo. Mèimei: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái zhǎo ge yòu cōngmíng yòu yǒu qián, érqiě hěn tǐtiē wǒ de nánpéngyou. Jiějie: Nǐ de yǎnguāng tài gāo le, kǒngpà zhǎo bú dào.
examples.english: Miss Bao has a good eye; she can tell at a glance that the quality of that yellow coat is the best. Younger sister: I hope to find a boyfriend in the future who is smart, rich, and very considerate of me. Older sister: Your standards are too high; I'm afraid you won't find one.

examples.chinese: 張太太上個月生了一個女兒，我寫了一張卡片祝福她，希望孩子快快樂樂地長大。 我的孩子滿月時，收到很多朋友送的禮物和滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai shàng ge yuè shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér, wǒ xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn zhùfú tā, xīwàng háizi kuàikuàilèlè de zhǎngdà. Wǒ de háizi mǎnyuè shí, shōudào hěn duō péngyou sòng de lǐwù hé mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang gave birth to a daughter last month. I wrote a card to bless her, hoping the child will grow up happily. When my child was one month old, we received many gifts from friends and full blessings.

examples.chinese: 尚恩是家豪的好朋友，非常清楚他的個性，連他喜歡吃什麼都很清楚。
examples.pinyin: Shàng'ēn shì Jiāháo de hǎo péngyou, fēicháng qīngchǔ tā de gèxìng, lián tā xǐhuān chī shénme dōu hěn qīngchǔ.
examples.english: Shawn is Jiahao's good friend and is very clear about his personality; he is even very clear about what he likes to eat.

examples.chinese: 朋友的孩子滿月了，我想送他一份禮，祝福他平平安安地長大。
examples.pinyin: Péngyou de háizi mǎnyuè le, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí fèn lǐ, zhùfú tā píngpíng'ān'ān de zhǎngdà.
examples.english: My friend's child has reached one month old. I want to give him a present, wishing him to grow up safely and soundly.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友到餐廳點了好多菜，最後沒吃完，只好打包回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyou dào cāntīng diǎn le hǎo duō cài, zuìhòu méi chī wán, zhǐhǎo dǎbāo huí jiā.
examples.english: My friend and I went to a restaurant and ordered a lot of dishes. In the end, we couldn't finish them, so we had to pack them to take home.

examples.chinese: 我去參加朋友的婚禮，除了送紅包，還祝福他們事事如意、早生貴子、永遠幸福。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù cānjiā péngyou de hūnlǐ, chúle sòng hóngbāo, hái zhùfú tāmen shìshì rúyì, zǎo shēng guìzǐ, yǒngyuǎn xìngfú.
examples.english: I went to attend a friend's wedding; besides giving a red envelope, I also wished them that everything goes as they wish, that they soon have a child, and that they be happy forever.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友昨天去河邊露營， 我們試著在河裡抓魚，沒想到真的抓到了五條魚。金先生親眼見過警察在街上抓小偷，一個跑來跑去，一個追來追去，他覺得太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu zuótiān qù hébiān lùyíng, wǒmen shìzhe zài hé lǐ zhuā yú, méi xiǎngdào zhēn de zhuā dào le wǔ tiáo yú. Jīn xiānsheng qīnyǎn jiàn guò jǐngchá zài jiē shàng zhuā xiǎotōu, yī ge pǎo lái pǎo qù, yī ge zhuī lái zhuī qù, tā juéde tài cìjī le.
examples.english: My friend and I went camping by the river yesterday; we tried to catch fish in the river, and unexpectedly, we really caught five fish. Mr. Jin has seen with his own eyes the police catching a thief on the street—one running back and forth, the other chasing back and forth—he thought it was too exciting.

examples.chinese: 我在山上工作，手機的訊號很弱，朋友常抱怨我的電話不是打不通，就是聲音不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài shānshàng gōngzuò, shǒujī de xìnhào hěn ruò, péngyǒu cháng bàoyuàn wǒ de diànhuà bú shì dǎ bù tōng, jiù shì shēngyīn bù qīngchu.
examples.english: I work in the mountains, and the cell phone signal is very weak. My friends often complain that my phone either can't be reached or the voice is unclear.

examples.chinese: 我奶奶不會用電腦，每次想跟朋友連絡，不是去郵局寄信就是打家裡的電話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai bú huì yòng diànnǎo, měi cì xiǎng gēn péngyǒu liánluò, bú shì qù yóujú jì xìn jiù shì dǎ jiālǐ de diànhuà.
examples.english: My grandmother doesn't know how to use a computer. Every time she wants to contact her friends, she either goes to the post office to mail a letter or calls the home phone.

examples.chinese: 我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le. A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english: My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding. A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese: 真正的朋友會幫助你、關心你，是絕對不會傷害你的。青少年常因為不了解而誤會父母的教育方式，或許等他們長大了，就能真正明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì bāngzhù nǐ, guānxīn nǐ, shì juéduì bù huì shānghài nǐ de. Qīngshàonián cháng yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér wùhuì fùmǔ de jiàoyù fāngshì, huòxǔ děng tāmen zhǎngdà le, jiù néng zhēnzhèng míngbai le.
examples.english: True friends will help you and care about you; they will absolutely not hurt you. Teenagers often misunderstand their parents' way of education because they don't understand; perhaps when they grow up, they will truly understand.

examples.chinese: 小戴第一次跟女朋友的父母見面時，緊張得不得了，說話、吃飯都很不自在。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài dì yī cì gēn nǚpéngyǒu de fùmǔ jiànmiàn shí, jǐnzhāng de bùdéliǎo, shuōhuà, chīfàn dōu hěn bù zìzài.
examples.english: When Xiǎo Dài met his girlfriend's parents for the first time, he was extremely nervous, and he was very uncomfortable both talking and eating.

examples.chinese: 去朋友家以前，一定要約好時間才去，這是做人的基本禮貌。孔子認為對人有禮貌、尊敬老師、孝順父母，是做人的基本。
examples.pinyin: Qù péngyǒu jiā yǐqián, yīdìng yào yuēhǎo shíjiān cái qù, zhè shì zuòrén de jīběn lǐmào. Kǒngzǐ rènwéi duì rén yǒu lǐmào, zūnjìng lǎoshī, xiàoshùn fùmǔ, shì zuòrén de jīběn.
examples.english: Before going to a friend's house, you must set a time before going; this is basic courtesy in dealing with people. Confucius believed that being polite to others, respecting teachers, and being filial to parents are the basics of being a person.

examples.chinese: 我的法國朋友最初只計畫來臺灣學中文，沒想到後來拿到了獎學金，還念了博士班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Fǎguó péngyǒu zuìchū zhǐ jìhuà lái Táiwān xué Zhōngwén, méi xiǎngdào hòulái nádàole jiǎngxuéjīn, hái niànle bóshìbān.
examples.english: At first, my French friend only planned to come to Taiwan to study Chinese; unexpectedly, later he received a scholarship and even studied in a doctoral program.

examples.chinese: 他把所有的錢都給了女朋友，直到女朋友被警察抓了，才知道自己被騙。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de qián dōu gěi le nǚpéngyǒu, zhídào nǚpéngyǒu bèi jǐngchá zhuā le, cái zhīdào zìjǐ bèi piàn.
examples.english: He gave all his money to his girlfriend, and only when his girlfriend was caught by the police did he realize he had been cheated.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方很偏僻，手機常收不到訊息，朋友很難跟我聯絡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng hěn piānpì, shǒujī cháng shōu bù dào xùnxí, péngyǒu hěn nán gēn wǒ liánluò.
examples.english: The place I live is very remote; my phone often can't receive information, and it's hard for friends to contact me.

examples.chinese: A:要不是你幫忙，現在我還找不到工作呢！ B:沒什麼，朋友之間本來就應該互相幫助。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàobùshì nǐ bāngmáng, xiànzài wǒ hái zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò ne! B: Méi shénme, péngyǒu zhījiān běnlái jiù yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù.
examples.english: A: If it weren't for your help, I still wouldn't have found a job now! B: It's nothing; between friends, we should help each other by nature.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: A:要是你發現男朋友對你越來越冷淡，還常跟女網友約會， 你會原諒他嗎？ B:這麼花心的男人，絕對不值得原諒。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàoshi nǐ fāxiàn nánpéngyou duì nǐ yuèláiyuè lěngdàn, hái cháng gēn nǚ wǎngyǒu yuēhuì, nǐ huì yuánliàng tā ma? B: Zhème huāxīn de nánrén, juéduì bù zhídé yuánliàng.
examples.english: A: If you found out that your boyfriend was becoming colder and colder toward you and often went on dates with female internet friends, would you forgive him? B: A man who is such a playboy is absolutely not worth forgiving.

examples.chinese: 小簡今天遇到以前的女朋友，跟她喝了咖啡才回家，但不敢跟太太說實話。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn jīntiān yùdào yǐqián de nǚpéngyǒu, gēn tā hē le kāfēi cái huí jiā, dàn bù gǎn gēn tàitai shuō shíhuà.
examples.english: Today Xiao Jian ran into his ex-girlfriend, and only went home after having coffee with her, but he didn't dare tell his wife the truth.

examples.chinese: 我男朋友親手做了一張卡片，還買了一個漂亮的背包送給我， 他的心意讓我很感動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nánpéngyou qīnshǒu zuò le yì zhāng kǎpiàn, hái mǎi le yí ge piàoliang de bēibāo sòng gěi wǒ, tā de xīnyì ràng wǒ hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: My boyfriend personally made a card and also bought a beautiful backpack to give me; his kindly feelings moved me very much.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: 元真，我們明天幾點去找妳的韓國朋友？
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, wǒmen míngtiān jǐ diǎn qù zhǎo nǐ de Hánguó péngyǒu?
examples.english: Yuanzhen, what time are we going to meet up with your Korean friends tomorrow?

examples.chinese: 朋友常來找我，他們都覺得坐捷運來我家，又快又方便。
examples.pinyin: Péngyǒu cháng lái zhǎo wǒ, tāmen dōu juéde zuò jiéyùn lái wǒ jiā, yòu kuài yòu fāngbiàn.
examples.english: My friends often visit me. They all think taking the MRT to my house is both fast and convenient.

examples.chinese: 我朋友最近比較忙，別的時間他沒有空。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu zuìjìn bǐjiào máng, biéde shíjiān tā méi yǒukòng.
examples.english: My friend is busier lately; he isn’t available at other times.

examples.chinese: 最近我的台灣朋友想學日文，請我教他，我也請他教我中文。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn wǒ de Táiwān péngyǒu xiǎng xué Rìwén, qǐng wǒ jiāo tā, wǒ yě qǐng tā jiāo wǒ Zhōngwén.
examples.english: These days, one of my Taiwanese friends wants to learn Japanese. He asked me to teach him Japanese, so I asked him to teach me Chinese as well.

examples.chinese: 這是我朋友做的，因為他屬虎。妳知道十二生肖嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ péngyou zuò de, yīnwèi tā shǔ hǔ. Nǐ zhīdào shí'èr shēngxiào ma?
examples.english: This is the lantern that my friend made because his Chinese zodiac animal sign is tiger. Do you know the Chinese animal zodiac?

items.wordHook: 朋(companion) + 友(friend) → 朋友 is a friend.

examples.chinese: 這個孩子眼睛不太好，所以每天都戴眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi yǎnjing bù tài hǎo, suǒyǐ měitiān dōu dài yǎnjìng.
examples.english: This child's eyes are not very good, so he wears glasses every day.

examples.chinese: 為了避免皮膚受傷，夏天出門時別忘了戴上帽子和太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn pífū shòushāng, xiàtiān chūmén shí bié wàng le dài shàng màozi hé tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: To avoid skin injury, don't forget to put on a hat and sunglasses when going out in summer.

examples.chinese: 強烈的陽光對我們的眼睛不好，出門活動時最好戴上太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè de yángguāng duì wǒmen de yǎnjing bù hǎo, chūmén huódòng shí zuìhǎo dài shàng tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: Strong sunlight is bad for our eyes; when going out for activities, it's best to wear sunglasses.

examples.chinese: 那個眼鏡的金屬材料相當特別，因此價格比一般眼鏡貴三成。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge yǎnjìng de jīnshǔ cáiliào xiāngdāng tèbié, yīncǐ jiàgé bǐ yībān yǎnjìng guì sān chéng.
examples.english: The metal material of those glasses is quite special, so the price is thirty percent more expensive than ordinary glasses.

examples.chinese: 他上班時常戴著一副黑色眼鏡，那副樣子總是讓我忘不了。
examples.pinyin: Tā shàngbān shí cháng dài zhe yī fù hēisè yǎnjìng, nà fù yàngzi zǒngshì ràng wǒ wàng bù liǎo.
examples.english: When he goes to work, he often wears a pair of black glasses; that look always makes me unable to forget it.

items.wordHook: 眼(eye) + 鏡(lens) → lenses for the eyes: 眼鏡(glasses).

examples.chinese: 這件事情他自己可以做，不需要我們幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng tā zìjǐ kěyǐ zuò, bù xūyào wǒmen bāngmáng.
examples.english: He can do this matter himself; he doesn't need our help.

examples.chinese: 在外國跟在自己國家的生活一定不太一樣。
examples.pinyin: Zài wàiguó gēn zài zìjǐ guójiā de shēnghuó yídìng bú tài yíyàng.
examples.english: Living in a foreign country and living in your own country are definitely not quite the same.

examples.chinese: 我可以自己回家，你不用陪我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ zìjǐ huí jiā, nǐ bùyòng péi wǒ.
examples.english: I can go home by myself; you don't need to accompany me.

examples.chinese: 媽媽不在，晚飯我得自己弄。弟弟把房間弄得又髒又亂，誰也不想進去。
examples.pinyin: Māma bù zài, wǎnfàn wǒ děi zìjǐ nòng. Dìdi bǎ fángjiān nòng de yòu zāng yòu luàn, shéi yě bù xiǎng jìnqù.
examples.english: Mom isn't home, so I have to make dinner myself. My little brother made the room both dirty and messy; no one wants to go in.

examples.chinese: 第一次約會的時候，林先生感覺(到)自己很緊張。這棟公寓除了環境不錯，家具還很新，感覺住起來會很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Dì yī cì yuēhuì de shíhou, Lín xiānsheng gǎnjué (dào) zìjǐ hěn jǐnzhāng. Zhè dòng gōngyù chúle huánjìng búcuò, jiājù hái hěn xīn, gǎnjué zhù qǐlái huì hěn shūfu.
examples.english: On their first date, Mr. Lin felt that he was very nervous. Besides having a nice environment, this apartment building also has very new furniture; it feels like it would be very comfortable to live in.

examples.chinese: 參加團體旅遊比較不自由，可是不必自己訂旅館、訂車票。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐjiào bù zìyóu, kěshì bùbì zìjǐ dìng lǚguǎn, dìng chēpiào.
examples.english: Joining a group tour is less free, but you don't have to book hotels and tickets yourself.

examples.chinese: 陳可欣覺得方靜文變了，可是靜文覺得自己沒變。
examples.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn juéde Fāng Jìngwén biàn le, kěshì Jìngwén juéde zìjǐ méi biàn.
examples.english: Chen Kexin feels that Fang Jingwen has changed, but Jingwen feels that she herself hasn't changed.

examples.chinese: 那個外國學生常跟台灣朋友聊天，用中文表達自己的意見。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wàiguó xuéshēng cháng gēn Táiwān péngyǒu liáotiān, yòng Zhōngwén biǎodá zìjǐ de yìjiàn.
examples.english: That foreign student often chats with Taiwanese friends, expressing his own opinions in Chinese.

examples.chinese: 那個外國學生常跟台灣朋友聊天，用中文表達自己的意見。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wàiguó xuéshēng cháng gēn Táiwān péngyǒu liáotiān, yòng Zhōngwén biǎodá zìjǐ de yìjiàn.
examples.english: That foreign student often chats with Taiwanese friends, expressing his own opinions in Chinese.

examples.chinese: 很多父母希望孩子照他們的意思做，因為怕孩子自己做不好。
examples.pinyin: Hěnduō fùmǔ xīwàng háizi zhào tāmen de yìsi zuò, yīnwèi pà háizi zìjǐ zuò bù hǎo.
examples.english: Many parents hope their children will do things according to their wishes, because they are afraid the children won't do well on their own.

examples.chinese: 那個小孩年紀太小，不會自己穿衣服、脫褲子。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái niánjì tài xiǎo, bù huì zìjǐ chuān yīfu, tuō kùzi.
examples.english: That child is too young; he can't put on clothes or take off his pants by himself.

examples.chinese: 參加社團活動，是讓自己成長的好機會。孩子出國留學以後，父母發現孩子成長了不少。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā shètuán huódòng, shì ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng de hǎo jīhuì. Háizi chūguó liúxué yǐhòu, fùmǔ fāxiàn háizi chéngzhǎng le bùshǎo.
examples.english: Participating in club activities is a good opportunity for personal growth. After their child went abroad to study, the parents found that the child had grown a lot.

examples.chinese: 很多大學生都打過工，因為得自己付生活費。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō dàxuéshēng dōu dǎ guò gōng, yīnwèi děi zìjǐ fù shēnghuófèi.
examples.english: Many university students have had part-time jobs because they have to pay their own living expenses.

examples.chinese: 他非常不愛惜自己的東西，所以東西常不見。
examples.pinyin: Tā fēicháng bù àixī zìjǐ de dōngxi, suǒyǐ dōngxi cháng bùjiàn.
examples.english: He doesn't cherish his own things at all, so his things often go missing.

examples.chinese: 他上禮拜去買電腦，差點兒就忘了自己的手機，真糊塗！
examples.pinyin: Tā shàng lǐbài qù mǎi diànnǎo, chàdiǎnr jiù wàng le zìjǐ de shǒujī, zhēn hútú!
examples.english: Last week he went to buy a computer and almost forgot his own cell phone—so forgetful!

examples.chinese: 他上禮拜去買電腦，差點就忘了自己的手機，真糊塗！
examples.pinyin: Tā shàng lǐbài qù mǎi diànnǎo, chàdiǎn jiù wàng le zìjǐ de shǒujī, zhēn hútú!
examples.english: Last week he went to buy a computer and almost forgot his own cell phone—really silly!

examples.chinese: 我餓的時候，會自己煮飯、煮水餃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ è de shíhou, huì zìjǐ zhǔ fàn, zhǔ shuǐjiǎo.
examples.english: When I am hungry, I cook rice and boil dumplings myself.

examples.chinese: 我餓的時候，會自己煮飯、煮水餃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ è de shíhou, huì zìjǐ zhǔ fàn, zhǔ shuǐjiǎo.
examples.english: When I am hungry, I cook rice and boil dumplings myself.

examples.chinese: 妹妹知道自己考上了最好的研究所，激動地哭了起來。
examples.pinyin: Mèimei zhīdào zìjǐ kǎo shàng le zuì hǎo de yánjiūsuǒ, jīdòng de kū le qǐlái.
examples.english: When my younger sister learned that she had gotten into the best graduate school, she was so excited that she started crying.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己特殊的風俗習慣，有時候外國人不容易了解。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ tèshū de fēngsú xíguàn, yǒu shíhou wàiguó rén bù róngyì liǎojiě.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own special customs and habits, which sometimes foreigners find hard to understand.

examples.chinese: 大華為了參加唱歌比賽，除了每天不斷地練習，也把自己唱的歌錄下來聽一聽，希望能唱得更好。雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。
examples.pinyin: Dàhuá wèile cānjiā chànggē bǐsài, chúle měitiān bùduàn de liànxí, yě bǎ zìjǐ chàng de gē lù xiàlái tīng yī tīng, xīwàng néng chàng de gèng hǎo. Suīrán Lù xiānsheng zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò jīhuì bùduàn, dànshì yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo de guānxi yīzhí méi bànfǎ qù shàngbān.
examples.english: In order to participate in the singing competition, Dahua not only practices continuously every day, but also records his own singing to listen to, hoping to sing better. Although Mr. Lu has had continuous job opportunities these past few years, because of poor health he has never been able to go to work.

examples.chinese: 何小姐是一名模特兒，也會自己設計服裝，這幾張圖裡的裙子都是她畫的。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě shì yī míng mótè'ér, yě huì zìjǐ shèjì fúzhuāng, zhè jǐ zhāng tú lǐ de qúnzi dōu shì tā huà de.
examples.english: Miss He is a model and can also design clothes herself. The skirts in these pictures were all drawn by her.

examples.chinese: 大偉挺喜歡他現在的工作，不但能挑戰自己，也能學習新的東西。
examples.pinyin: Dàwěi tǐng xǐhuān tā xiànzài de gōngzuò, bùdàn néng tiǎozhàn zìjǐ, yě néng xuéxí xīn de dōngxi.
examples.english: Dawei quite likes his current job; not only can it challenge him, but he can also learn new things.

examples.chinese: 這道菜能夠這麼好吃，是因為加了特別的醬料，還有自己做的醬油。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài nénggòu zhème hǎochī, shì yīnwèi jiāle tèbié de jiàngliào, hái yǒu zìjǐ zuò de jiàngyóu.
examples.english: This dish can be so delicious because it has special sauce added, plus homemade soy sauce.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time.

examples.chinese: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.
examples.english: The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star.

examples.chinese: 這個城市的公車司機不找錢，要是你沒有公車卡，就得自己準備零錢。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de gōngchē sījī bù zhǎo qián, yàoshi nǐ méiyǒu gōngchē kǎ, jiù děi zìjǐ zhǔnbèi língqián.
examples.english: Bus drivers in this city don't give change; if you don't have a bus card, you have to prepare exact change yourself.

examples.chinese: 每個人都有自己的優點，不需要強調，也不必跟別人比來比去。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de yōudiǎn, bù xūyào qiángdiào, yě búbì gēn biérén bǐ lái bǐ qù.
examples.english: Everyone has their own strengths; there is no need to emphasize them, and no need to compare yourself with others back and forth.

examples.chinese: 這裡的每一樣產品都是老闆自己設計的，別的地方找不到相同的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de měi yí yàng chǎnpǐn dōu shì lǎobǎn zìjǐ shèjì de, bié de dìfang zhǎo bú dào xiāngtóng de.
examples.english: Every kind of product here is designed by the owner himself; you can't find the same ones elsewhere.

examples.chinese: 任何人都應該認真思考自己的未來，別糊里糊塗地過日子。
examples.pinyin: Rènhé rén dōu yīnggāi rènzhēn sīkǎo zìjǐ de wèilái, bié húlǐhútú de guò rìzi.
examples.english: Everyone should seriously think about their own future, and not live their days muddleheadedly.

examples.chinese: 地震時要保護自己的安全，最重要的是避免頭部受傷。當地震發生時，我們應該怎麼做呢？
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn shí yào bǎohù zìjǐ de ānquán, zuì zhòngyào de shì bìmiǎn tóubù shòushāng. Dāng dìzhèn fāshēng shí, wǒmen yīnggāi zěnme zuò ne?
examples.english: During an earthquake, you must protect your own safety; the most important thing is to avoid head injury. When an earthquake occurs, what should we do?

examples.chinese: 沒有人知道自己的命能有多長， 所以每天都應該好好過日子。不少人相信人的命是被決定的， 誰都改變不了。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén zhīdào zìjǐ de mìng néng yǒu duō cháng, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guò rìzi. Bùshǎo rén xiāngxìn rén de mìng shì bèi juédìng de, shéi dōu gǎibiàn bù liǎo.
examples.english: No one knows how long their own life can be, so every day one should live life well. Many people believe that a person's fate is decided, and no one can change it.

examples.chinese: 珍珍每天大約看兩個小時的臺灣連續劇，目的是要(訓)練自己的中文聽力。大雄常利用週末練(習)書法，所以漢字寫得比其他同學都好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhēn měitiān dàyuē kàn liǎng ge xiǎoshí de Táiwān liánxùjù, mùdì shì yào xùnliàn zìjǐ de Zhōngwén tīnglì. Dàxióng cháng lìyòng zhōumò liànxí shūfǎ, suǒyǐ Hànzì xiě de bǐ qítā tóngxué dōu hǎokàn.
examples.english: Zhenzhen watches about two hours of Taiwanese TV dramas every day; her purpose is to train her Chinese listening comprehension. Daxiong often uses his weekends to practice calligraphy, so he writes Chinese characters more beautifully than any of his classmates.

examples.chinese: 跟團體旅遊比起來，我覺得一個人的旅行自由得多，也能訓練自己解決問題的能力。
examples.pinyin: Gēn tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐ qǐlái, wǒ juéde yí ge rén de lǚxíng zìyóu de duō, yě néng xùnliàn zìjǐ jiějué wèntí de nénglì.
examples.english: Compared with group travel, I think traveling alone is much freer, and it can also train your ability to solve problems on your own.

examples.chinese: 這個平板的使用說明寫得很詳細，客人自己看就能明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège píngbǎn de shǐyòng shuōmíng xiě de hěn xiángxì, kèrén zìjǐ kàn jiù néng míngbai le.
examples.english: The user manual for this tablet is written in great detail; customers can understand it just by reading it themselves.

examples.chinese: 林小姐從小就希望有一家屬於自己的麵包店，今年終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě cóngxiǎo jiù xīwàng yǒu yī jiā shǔyú zìjǐ de miànbāodiàn, jīnnián zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn le.
examples.english: Miss Lin has hoped since childhood to have a bakery that belongs to herself; this year her dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 小畢本來認為自己的書法寫得很好，但是上次比賽輸了以後，他就失去自信了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Bì běnlái rènwéi zìjǐ de shūfǎ xiě de hěn hǎo, dànshì shàng cì bǐsài shū le yǐhòu, tā jiù shīqù zìxìn le.
examples.english: Xiǎo Bì originally thought his calligraphy was very good, but after losing the last competition, he lost his self-confidence.

examples.chinese: 我認為多看時尚雜誌、多看模特兒怎麼穿衣服，應該就能使自己的穿著更有品味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi duō kàn shíshàng zázhì, duō kàn mótè'er zěnme chuān yīfu, yīnggāi jiù néng shǐ zìjǐ de chuānzhuó gèng yǒu pǐnwèi.
examples.english: I think that by reading more fashion magazines and looking more at how models wear clothes, you should be able to make your own clothing more tasteful.

examples.chinese: 我覺得馬小姐找不到工作的原因不是自己的條件不夠好，是他太缺乏自信了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Mǎ xiǎojiě zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò de yuányīn bùshì zìjǐ de tiáojiàn bù gòu hǎo, shì tā tài quēfá zìxìn le.
examples.english: I think the reason Miss Ma can't find a job is not that her own qualifications aren't good enough, but that she lacks self-confidence too much.

examples.chinese: 陳先生有五個孩子，生活費負擔很大。小張不想增加父親的負擔，為了負擔自己的學費，一下課就去打工。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānsheng yǒu wǔ gè háizi, shēnghuófèi fùdān hěn dà. Xiǎo Zhāng bù xiǎng zēngjiā fùqīn de fùdān, wèile fùdān zìjǐ de xuéfèi, yī xiàkè jiù qù dǎgōng.
examples.english: Mr. Chen has five children, so the burden of living expenses is very great. Little Zhang doesn't want to increase his father's burden; in order to shoulder his own tuition, he goes to work as soon as class is over.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 電影明星一向很重視自己的穿著，合適的穿著才能讓他們更有品味、更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng míngxīng yīxiàng hěn zhòngshì zìjǐ de chuānzhuó, héshì de chuānzhuó cái néng ràng tāmen gèng yǒu pǐnwèi, gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Movie stars have always attached great importance to their clothing; only suitable clothing can make them have more taste and more confidence.

examples.chinese: 張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le. Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard. Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān. Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english: A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach. Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese: 父母不能保護孩子一輩子，得讓他們自己經驗一些挫折，才能培養出堅強的性格。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ bù néng bǎohù háizi yībèizi, děi ràng tāmen zìjǐ jīngyàn yīxiē cuòzhé, cái néng péiyǎng chū jiānqiáng de xìnggé.
examples.english: Parents cannot protect their children for a lifetime; they must let them experience some frustrations themselves in order to cultivate a strong character.

examples.chinese: 只要你堅持每天學習一個小時的中文，我保證你的程度一定會越來越好的。石先生對自己的想法很堅持，從不接受別人的意見，所以很難相處。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí měitiān xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén, wǒ bǎozhèng nǐ de chéngdù yídìng huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de. Shí xiānsheng duì zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ hěn jiānchí, cóng bù jiēshòu biérén de yìjiàn, suǒyǐ hěn nán xiāngchǔ.
examples.english: As long as you insist on studying Chinese for one hour every day, I guarantee your level will definitely get better and better. Mr. Shi is very insistent on his own ideas and never accepts others' opinions, so he is hard to get along with.

examples.chinese: 他把所有的錢都給了女朋友，直到女朋友被警察抓了，才知道自己被騙。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de qián dōu gěi le nǚpéngyǒu, zhídào nǚpéngyǒu bèi jǐngchá zhuā le, cái zhīdào zìjǐ bèi piàn.
examples.english: He gave all his money to his girlfriend, and only when his girlfriend was caught by the police did he realize he had been cheated.

examples.chinese: 從小父母就教導我要做個好人，別讓人看不起自己。
examples.pinyin: Cóngxiǎo fùmǔ jiù jiàodǎo wǒ yào zuò ge hǎorén, bié ràng rén kànbuqǐ zìjǐ.
examples.english: Since I was little, my parents taught me to be a good person and not let others look down on me.

examples.chinese: 透過社群網站，我們可以加入感興趣的社團，讓自己的生活更充實。
examples.pinyin: Tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, wǒmen kěyǐ jiārù gǎn xìngqù de shètuán, ràng zìjǐ de shēnghuó gèng chōngshí.
examples.english: Through social media, we can join clubs we are interested in, making our lives more fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 人人都希望自己的孩子有幸福的生活、美好的未來。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu xīwàng zìjǐ de háizi yǒu xìngfú de shēnghuó, měihǎo de wèilái.
examples.english: Everyone hopes their children will have a happy life and a beautiful future.

examples.chinese: 你忙不過來的時候就該找人幫忙，別讓自己累壞了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ máng bú guòlái de shíhou jiù gāi zhǎo rén bāngmáng, bié ràng zìjǐ lèihuài le.
examples.english: When you are too busy to manage, you should find someone to help; don't let yourself get exhausted.

examples.chinese: 杜先生是三家網路商店的主管，他希望將來能當大企業的老闆，擁有自己的事業。
examples.pinyin: Dù xiānsheng shì sān jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn de zhǔguǎn, tā xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng dà qǐyè de lǎobǎn, yǒngyǒu zìjǐ de shìyè.
examples.english: Mr. Du is the manager of three online stores; he hopes that in the future he can become the boss of a big enterprise and have his own career.

examples.chinese: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.
examples.english: Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem.

examples.chinese: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.
examples.english: Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to.

examples.chinese: 在國外工作的那幾年，他學會了什麼問題都自己解決，不依靠別人。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài gōngzuò de nà jǐ nián, tā xuéhuì le shénme wèntí dōu zìjǐ jiějué, bù yīkào biérén.
examples.english: In those few years working abroad, he learned to solve every problem himself, not relying on others.

examples.chinese: 外國人在臺灣生活期間，如果遇到任何問題，都可以打0800-024111，請求協助。那個壞人殺了人，他知道自己錯了，到教堂去請求上帝原諒。
examples.pinyin: 1. Wàiguórén zài Táiwān shēnghuó qījiān, rúguǒ yùdào rènhé wèntí, dōu kěyǐ dǎ 0800-024111, qǐngqiú xiézhù. 2. Nàge huàirén shā le rén, tā zhīdào zìjǐ cuò le, dào jiàotáng qù qǐngqiú Shàngdì yuánliàng.
examples.english: 1. During their time living in Taiwan, if foreigners encounter any problems, they can call 0800-024111 to request assistance. 2. That bad person killed someone; he knew he was wrong and went to church to beg God for forgiveness.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己獨特的習俗，像華人除夕貼春聯、年夜飯的魚不能吃光就很特別。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ dútè de xísú, xiàng Huárén chúxī tiē chūnlián, niányèfàn de yú bù néng chī guāng jiù hěn tèbié.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own unique customs. For example, it is very special that Chinese people put up spring couplets on New Year's Eve and that the fish for the New Year's Eve dinner cannot be completely eaten.

examples.chinese: 有時候孩子不明白自己到底犯了什麼錯，父母應該好好跟他們溝通。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushíhou háizi bù míngbai zìjǐ dàodǐ fàn le shénme cuò, fùmǔ yīnggāi hǎohǎo gēn tāmen gōutōng.
examples.english: Sometimes children don't understand what mistake they have actually made; parents should communicate well with them.

examples.chinese: 《生日快樂》是全世界著名的歌曲，不同國家的人也能用自己的語言唱出來。
examples.pinyin: 《Shēngrì Kuàilè》 shì quán shìjiè zhùmíng de gēqǔ, bùtóng guójiā de rén yě néng yòng zìjǐ de yǔyán chàng chūlái.
examples.english: "Happy Birthday" is a world-famous song; people from different countries can also sing it in their own languages.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己的語言和文字，也用它們來記錄歷史。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ de yǔyán hé wénzì, yě yòng tāmen lái jìlù lìshǐ.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own language and writing, and also uses them to record history.

examples.chinese: 姊姊有了自己的孩子以後，才體會到當父母是很辛苦的。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie yǒu le zìjǐ de háizi yǐhòu, cái tǐhuì dào dāng fùmǔ shì hěn xīnkǔ de.
examples.english: Only after having her own child did my older sister realize that being a parent is very hard.

examples.chinese: 博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin: 1. Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de. 2. Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english: 1. The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money. 2. Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 誰都無法告訴你生命的意義是什麼，只能自己去尋找答案。
examples.pinyin: Shéi dōu wúfǎ gàosù nǐ shēngmìng de yìyì shì shénme, zhǐ néng zìjǐ qù xúnzhǎo dá'àn.
examples.english: No one is able to tell you what the meaning of life is; you can only search for the answer yourself.

examples.chinese: 打破你們的碗盤是我的錯，我會對自己的行為負責，付你們這個費用。
examples.pinyin: Dǎpò nǐmen de wǎnpán shì wǒ de cuò, wǒ huì duì zìjǐ de xíngwéi fùzé, fù nǐmen zhège fèiyòng.
examples.english: Breaking your dishes was my fault; I will take responsibility for my behavior and pay you this fee.

examples.chinese: 自己開店做老闆，事事都得自己來，其實不太容易。
examples.pinyin: Zìjǐ kāidiàn zuò lǎobǎn, shìshì dōu děi zìjǐ lái, qíshí bù tài róngyì.
examples.english: Opening your own shop and being the boss means you have to do everything yourself; actually, it's not that easy.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，收到禮物的人要找機會回禮，表達自己的感謝。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, shōudào lǐwù de rén yào zhǎo jīhuì huílǐ, biǎodá zìjǐ de gǎnxiè.
examples.english: In Taiwan, people who receive gifts should find an opportunity to give a gift in return to express their gratitude.

examples.chinese: 想讓別人看得起你，你得先看得起自己。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng ràng biérén kàndeqǐ nǐ, nǐ děi xiān kàndeqǐ zìjǐ.
examples.english: If you want others to show respect for you, you must first show respect for yourself.

examples.chinese: 一個人做錯事多半是自己造成的，不能一做錯就怪別人。
examples.pinyin: Yī ge rén zuòcuò shì duōbàn shì zìjǐ zàochéng de, bùnéng yī zuòcuò jiù guài biérén.
examples.english: When a person does something wrong, it is mostly caused by themselves; you can't just blame others as soon as you make a mistake.

examples.chinese: 他對自己很小氣，可是對朋友卻很大方。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zìjǐ hěn xiǎoqì, kěshì duì péngyǒu què hěn dàfāng.
examples.english: He is very stingy with himself, but he is very generous with friends.

examples.chinese: 人人都有屬於自己的長處，要對自己更有信心。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu yǒu shǔyú zìjǐ de chángchù, yào duì zìjǐ gèng yǒu xìnxīn.
examples.english: Everyone has their own strengths; you should have more confidence in yourself.

examples.chinese: 想吃得安心、吃得健康，自己親手做是必需的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng chī de ānxīn, chī de jiànkāng, zìjǐ qīnshǒu zuò shì bìxū de.
examples.english: If you want to eat with peace of mind and eat healthily, making it yourself is necessary.

examples.chinese: 我想加入社會服務組織，幫助別人的同時也讓自己成長。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng jiārù shèhuì fúwù zǔzhī, bāngzhù biérén de tóngshí yě ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: I want to join a social service organization; while helping others, I can also let myself grow.

examples.chinese: 我想出國當背包客，除了能打開視野，並能訓練自己更獨立。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chūguó dāng bēibāokè, chúle néng dǎkāi shìyě, bìng néng xùnliàn zìjǐ gèng dúlì.
examples.english: I want to go abroad as a backpacker; besides being able to broaden my horizons, and also train myself to be more independent.

examples.chinese: 他利用發傳單的方式來宣傳自己新開的餐廳。
examples.pinyin: Tā lìyòng fā chuándān de fāngshì lái xuānchuán zìjǐ xīn kāi de cāntīng.
examples.english: He uses the method of handing out fliers to promote his newly opened restaurant.

examples.chinese: 他願意挑戰自己的工作能力，並積極地克服挫折，真是難得。
examples.pinyin: Tā yuànyì tiǎozhàn zìjǐ de gōngzuò nénglì, bìng jījí de kèfú cuòzhé, zhēn shì nándé.
examples.english: He is willing to challenge his own work abilities and actively overcome setbacks; that is truly rare.

examples.chinese: 每個時代都有自己的價值標準，社會習俗及生活規矩也常隨著時代改變。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge shídài dōu yǒu zìjǐ de jiàzhí biāozhǔn, shèhuì xísú jí shēnghuó guījǔ yě cháng suízhe shídài gǎibiàn.
examples.english: Every era has its own value standards, and social customs and life rules also often change with the times.

examples.chinese: 人類破壞了自然，就是破壞了自己的生活環境。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi pòhuài le zìrán, jiù shì pòhuài le zìjǐ de shēnghuó huánjìng.
examples.english: When humans destroy nature, they are destroying their own living environment.

examples.chinese: 完全按照別人的話來工作，是很省事沒錯，卻失去了讓自己進步的機會。
examples.pinyin: Wánquán ànzhào biérén de huà lái gōngzuò, shì hěn shěngshì méicuò, què shīqù le ràng zìjǐ jìnbù de jīhuì.
examples.english: Working completely according to others' words is indeed very trouble-saving, but it loses the opportunity to let yourself improve.

examples.chinese: 他靠自己的力量，經過了十年，終於完成了這個發明。
examples.pinyin: Tā kào zìjǐ de lìliàng, jīngguò le shí nián, zhōngyú wánchéng le zhège fāmíng.
examples.english: Relying on his own strength, after ten years, he finally completed this invention.

examples.chinese: 練習八百公尺跑步時，教練除了要大家記得自己是跑第幾棒的，並且提醒我們把棒子拿好。
examples.pinyin: Liànxí bābǎi gōngchǐ pǎobù shí, jiàoliàn chúle yào dàjiā jìde zìjǐ shì pǎo dì jǐ bàng de, bìngqiě tíxǐng wǒmen bǎ bàngzi ná hǎo.
examples.english: When practicing the 800-meter run, the coach not only told everyone to remember which leg of the relay they were running, but also reminded us to hold the baton well.

examples.chinese: 對自己的事業很熱情的人，就不怕挑戰任何困難。
examples.pinyin: Duì zìjǐ de shìyè hěn rèqíng de rén, jiù bù pà tiǎozhàn rènhé kùnnán.
examples.english: People who are very passionate about their careers are not afraid to challenge any difficulties.

examples.chinese: 所有令人傷腦筋的過程，都是為了使自己變成腦筋很好的人。
examples.pinyin: Suǒyǒu lìng rén shāng nǎojīn de guòchéng, dōu shì wèile shǐ zìjǐ biànchéng nǎojīn hěn hǎo de rén.
examples.english: All the brain-racking processes are for the purpose of making oneself a person with a good brain.

examples.chinese: 那位母親寧可犧牲自己的生命，也要保護孩子的安全。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi mǔqīn nìngkě xīshēng zìjǐ de shēngmìng, yě yào bǎohù háizi de ānquán.
examples.english: That mother would rather sacrifice her own life to protect her child's safety.

examples.chinese: 所謂「人助天助」的意思，就是得自己先努力，天(God,Heavens)才會幫助你。
examples.pinyin: Suǒwèi “rén zhù tiān zhù” de yìsi, jiù shì děi zìjǐ xiān nǔlì, tiān cái huì bāngzhù nǐ.
examples.english: The so-called meaning of 'people help, Heaven helps' is that you must first work hard yourself, and only then will Heaven help you.

examples.chinese: 你的身體狀況不太好，就別自己開車了，讓我送你回家。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de shēntǐ zhuàngkuàng bú tài hǎo, jiù bié zìjǐ kāichē le, ràng wǒ sòng nǐ huí jiā.
examples.english: Your physical condition is not very good, so don't drive yourself; let me take you home.

examples.chinese: 參加旅行團或自助旅遊各有各的優點，懶得自己安排行程的人，就跟著導遊走吧。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā lǚxíngtuán huò zìzhù lǚyóu gè yǒu gè de yōudiǎn, lǎn de zìjǐ ānpái xíngchéng de rén, jiù gēnzhe dǎoyóu zǒu ba.
examples.english: Joining a tour group or traveling independently each has its own advantages; those who are too lazy to arrange their own itinerary should just follow the tour guide.

examples.chinese: 自從住校以後，我得學習自己收拾、整理房間。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng zhùxiào yǐhòu, wǒ děi xuéxí zìjǐ shōushi, zhěnglǐ fángjiān.
examples.english: Ever since I started living at school, I have had to learn to tidy up and organize my room myself.

examples.chinese: 有些運動中心規定個人得帶自己的毛巾，否則不可以進去。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē yùndòng zhōngxīn guīdìng gèrén děi dài zìjǐ de máojīn, fǒuzé bù kěyǐ jìnqù.
examples.english: Some sports centers require individuals to bring their own towels; otherwise, they cannot enter.

examples.chinese: 缺少運動的人總是說自己太忙，缺時間去活動。
examples.pinyin: Quēshǎo yùndòng de rén zǒngshì shuō zìjǐ tài máng, quē shíjiān qù huódòng.
examples.english: People who lack exercise always say they are too busy and lack time to get active.

examples.chinese: 知道自己誤會別人以後，最好早一點兒跟對方道歉。
examples.pinyin: Zhīdào zìjǐ wùhuì biérén yǐhòu, zuì hǎo zǎo yīdiǎnr gēn duìfāng dàoqiàn.
examples.english: After you realize you have misunderstood someone, it's best to apologize to the other person a bit earlier.

examples.chinese: 生活忙碌的時候，也要給自己留一些休息時間。
examples.pinyin: Shēnghuó mánglù de shíhou, yě yào gěi zìjǐ liú yīxiē xiūxi shíjiān.
examples.english: When life is busy, you should still leave yourself some time to rest.

examples.chinese: 自己做的肥皂用起來比較安心，也能選擇自己喜歡的氣味。
examples.pinyin: Zìjǐ zuò de féizào yòng qǐlái bǐjiào ānxīn, yě néng xuǎnzé zìjǐ xǐhuan de qìwèi.
examples.english: Soap made by yourself feels safer to use, and you can also choose the scent you like.

examples.chinese: A:你說自己沒有想做的事，難道你沒有夢想嗎？ B:我只想簡單過生活，再說，沒有夢想難道不行嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shuō zìjǐ méiyǒu xiǎng zuò de shì, nándào nǐ méiyǒu mèngxiǎng ma? B: Wǒ zhǐ xiǎng jiǎndān guò shēnghuó, zàishuō, méiyǒu mèngxiǎng nándào bùxíng ma?
examples.english: A: You say you have nothing you want to do—don't you have dreams? B: I just want to live a simple life; besides, is it not okay to have no dreams?

examples.chinese: 我們無法控制別人的行為，卻能夠改變自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wúfǎ kòngzhì biérén de xíngwéi, què nénggòu gǎibiàn zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: We cannot control other people's behavior, but we can change our own thoughts.

examples.chinese: 你不需要事事都跟別人做比較，自己過得輕鬆愉快就好。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù xūyào shìshì dōu gēn biérén zuò bǐjiào, zìjǐ guò de qīngsōng yúkuài jiù hǎo.
examples.english: You don't need to compare yourself with others in everything; it's fine as long as you live relaxed and happy.

examples.chinese: 有時一個人的前途無法先規劃好，必須自己創造。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushí yī gè rén de qiántú wúfǎ xiān guīhuà hǎo, bìxū zìjǐ chuàngzào.
examples.english: Sometimes a person's prospects cannot be planned out in advance; one must create them oneself.

examples.chinese: 到外面做了丟人的事，自己和家人也會覺得丟臉。
examples.pinyin: Dào wàimiàn zuò le diūrén de shì, zìjǐ hé jiārén yě huì juéde diūliǎn.
examples.english: If you go out and do something shameful, you and your family will also feel disgraced.

examples.chinese: 如果說能回到過去，我最想放下工作，追求自己的興趣。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒshuō néng huídào guòqù, wǒ zuì xiǎng fàngxià gōngzuò, zhuīqiú zìjǐ de xìngqù.
examples.english: If I could return to the past, I would most want to set aside work and pursue my own interests.

examples.chinese: 學習外國語言時最好能找位專業的老師，好改正自己的錯誤。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí wàiguó yǔyán shí zuìhǎo néng zhǎo wèi zhuānyè de lǎoshī, hǎo gǎizhèng zìjǐ de cuòwù.
examples.english: When learning a foreign language, it's best to find a professional teacher so as to correct your own mistakes.

examples.chinese: A:幸虧有你的建議，投資計畫才有很好的結果，真是多謝你了？ B:哪裡哪裡，都是你自己努力得到的成果，要謝就謝你自己吧！
examples.pinyin: A: Xìngkuī yǒu nǐ de jiànyì, tóuzī jìhuà cái yǒu hěn hǎo de jiéguǒ, zhēn shì duōxiè nǐ le? B: Nǎlǐ nǎlǐ, dōu shì nǐ zìjǐ nǔlì dédào de chéngguǒ, yào xiè jiù xiè nǐ zìjǐ ba!
examples.english: A: Thanks to your suggestion, the investment plan got a very good result; thank you so much! B: Not at all, it's all the result of your own hard work; if you want to thank anyone, thank yourself!

examples.chinese: 當我聽到被公司錄取的消息時，還以為是做夢，忍不住用力捏了自己一下。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ tīngdào bèi gōngsī lùqǔ de xiāoxi shí, hái yǐwéi shì zuòmèng, rěnbuzhù yònglì niēle zìjǐ yīxià.
examples.english: When I heard the news that I was hired by the company, I still thought I was dreaming, and I couldn't help but pinch myself hard.

examples.chinese: 王媽媽一直把媳婦當作自己的女兒，當他們家的媳婦真幸福。
examples.pinyin: Wáng māma yīzhí bǎ xífù dàngzuò zìjǐ de nǚ'ér, dāng tāmen jiā de xífù zhēn xìngfú.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang has always treated her daughter-in-law as her own daughter; being their family's daughter-in-law is truly blessed.

examples.chinese: 經過血液檢查，人們就可以知道自己的血型。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò xuèyè jiǎnchá, rénmen jiù kěyǐ zhīdào zìjǐ de xuèxíng.
examples.english: Through a blood test, people can know their own blood type.

examples.chinese: 她想嫁給有錢人家(rénjiā)是她自己的事，你幹嘛管人家(rénjia)的事？
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng jià gěi yǒuqián rénjiā shì tā zìjǐ de shì, nǐ gànmá guǎn rénjia de shì?
examples.english: That she wants to marry into a wealthy family is her own business; why do you meddle in other people's business?

examples.chinese: 天天說自己外行、不願嘗試的人，就無法更深入地瞭解世界。
examples.pinyin: Tiāntiān shuō zìjǐ wàiháng, bù yuàn chángshì de rén, jiù wúfǎ gèng shēnrù de liǎojiě shìjiè.
examples.english: People who say they are laymen every day and are unwilling to try cannot understand the world more deeply.

examples.chinese: 各行各業都有屬於自己的專業，無法比較誰高誰低。
examples.pinyin: Gè háng gè yè dōu yǒu shǔyú zìjǐ de zhuānyè, wúfǎ bǐjiào shéi gāo shéi dī.
examples.english: Every profession has its own specialty; it is impossible to compare who is higher and who is lower.

examples.chinese: 我習慣把每一筆支出都記錄起來，提醒自己少花點兒錢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn bǎ měi yì bǐ zhīchū dōu jìlù qǐlái, tíxǐng zìjǐ shǎo huā diǎnr qián.
examples.english: I am used to recording every expense, to remind myself to spend a little less money.

examples.chinese: 開車時不闖紅燈，是為了自己和別人的生命安全。
examples.pinyin: Kāichē shí bù chuǎng hóngdēng, shì wèile zìjǐ hé biérén de shēngmìng ānquán.
examples.english: Not running red lights when driving is for the safety of your own and others' lives.

examples.chinese: 當你願意開放自己的心時， 你所見的世界也會更加地美妙。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ yuànyì kāifàng zìjǐ de xīn shí, nǐ suǒ jiàn de shìjiè yě huì gèngjiā de měimiào.
examples.english: When you are willing to open your heart, the world you see will also become even more wonderful.

examples.chinese: 今天王醫師門診，沒有護理師協助，什麼事都得自己動手。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān Wáng yīshī ménzhěn, méiyǒu hùlǐshī xiézhù, shénme shì dōu děi zìjǐ dòngshǒu.
examples.english: Dr. Wang is seeing patients today, and without a nurse assisting, he has to set about everything himself.

examples.chinese: 隨著科技進步，醫學也不斷前進，當醫師的人得多充實自己。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì jìnbù, yīxué yě bùduàn qiánjìn, dāng yīshī de rén děi duō chōngshí zìjǐ.
examples.english: With technological progress, medicine also continuously advances; those who become doctors must enrich themselves a lot.

examples.chinese: 你在外面花錢吃不健康的食物，還不如自己在家煮。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài wàimiàn huāqián chī bù jiànkāng de shíwù, hái bùrú zìjǐ zài jiā zhǔ.
examples.english: You spend money eating unhealthy food outside; you'd be better off cooking at home yourself.

examples.chinese: 有人喜歡在枕頭上抹一點兒自己喜歡的香水，聽說可以紓壓。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén xǐhuān zài zhěntou shàng mǒ yīdiǎnr zìjǐ xǐhuān de xiāngshuǐ, tīngshuō kěyǐ shūyā.
examples.english: Some people like to dab a little of their favorite perfume on their pillow; it's said to relieve stress.

examples.chinese: 大學畢業後，同學們就奔向自己的人生目標，五年後才聚在一起。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué bìyè hòu, tóngxuémen jiù bēn xiàng zìjǐ de rénshēng mùbiāo, wǔ nián hòu cái jù zài yīqǐ.
examples.english: After graduating from university, classmates rush toward their own life goals, and only get together five years later.

examples.chinese: 他勸我別太在意別人的眼光，把自己負責的事完成就好。
examples.pinyin: Tā quàn wǒ bié tài zàiyì biérén de yǎnguāng, bǎ zìjǐ fùzé de shì wánchéng jiù hǎo.
examples.english: He advised me not to care too much about others' opinions, and to just complete the things I am responsible for.

examples.chinese: 雖然受到了重大的挫折，可是他並沒有放棄自己的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán shòudào le zhòngdà de cuòzhé, kěshì tā bìng méiyǒu fàngqì zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Although he suffered a major setback, he actually did not give up his dream.

examples.chinese: 父母總是捨得給孩子最好的，卻捨不得對自己好一點兒。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zǒngshì shědé gěi háizi zuì hǎo de, què shěbudé duì zìjǐ hǎo yīdiǎnr.
examples.english: Parents are always willing to give their children the best, yet they can't bear to treat themselves a little better.

examples.chinese: 這件事大家都堅持自己的觀點，討論不出結果，還是找個說話有分量的人來決定吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì dàjiā dōu jiānchí zìjǐ de guāndiǎn, tǎolùn bù chū jiéguǒ, háishì zhǎo gè shuōhuà yǒu fènliàng de rén lái juédìng ba.
examples.english: In this matter, everyone insists on their own viewpoint, and no result can be reached through discussion; it would be better to find someone whose words carry weight to decide.

examples.chinese: 每個宗教都有屬於自己的獨特儀式。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge zōngjiào dōu yǒu shǔyú zìjǐ de dútè yíshì.
examples.english: Every religion has its own unique ceremonies.

examples.chinese: 看到自己國家的國旗進入奧運會場，民眾也不斷揮著手上的小旗子，替自己的國家加油。
examples.pinyin: Kàn dào zìjǐ guójiā de guóqí jìnrù Àoyùn huìchǎng, mínzhòng yě búduàn huī zhe shǒu shàng de xiǎo qízi, tì zìjǐ de guójiā jiāyóu.
examples.english: Seeing their country's national flag enter the Olympic venue, the public also continuously waved the small flags in their hands to cheer for their country.

examples.chinese: 重道德的人，即使在沒人看見的地方也會注意自己的行為。
examples.pinyin: Zhòng dàodé de rén, jíshǐ zài méi rén kànjiàn de dìfāng yě huì zhùyì zìjǐ de xíngwéi.
examples.english: A person who values morality will pay attention to their behavior even in places where no one is watching.

items.wordHook: 自(self) + 己(self) → the self, yourself: 自己 means oneself.

examples.chinese: 這些碗筷、刀叉我都還沒擦乾，不可以給客人用。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē wǎnkuài, dāochā wǒ dōu hái méi cā gān, bù kěyǐ gěi kèrén yòng.
examples.english: I haven't dried these bowls, chopsticks, and cutlery yet; they can't be given to guests to use.

examples.chinese: 昨天洗的衣服乾了沒有？這些碗筷、刀叉我都還沒擦乾，不可以給客人用。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān xǐ de yīfu gān le méiyǒu? Zhèxiē wǎnkuài, dāochā wǒ dōu hái méi cā gān, bù kěyǐ gěi kèrén yòng.
examples.english: Are the clothes washed yesterday dry yet? I haven't dried these bowls, chopsticks, and cutlery yet; they can't be given to guests to use.

examples.chinese: 龍山寺是台北很有名的寺廟，廟裡常常有很多外國遊客。
examples.pinyin: Lóngshānsì shì Táiběi hěn yǒumíng de sìmiào, miào lǐ chángcháng yǒu hěn duō wàiguó yóukè.
examples.english: Longshan Temple is a very famous temple in Taipei; there are often many foreign tourists in the temple.

examples.chinese: 去那座寺廟拜拜的人真多，他們在拜什麼？
examples.pinyin: Qù nà zuò sìmiào bài bài de rén zhēn duō, tāmen zài bài shénme?
examples.english: There are really many people going to that temple to worship—what are they worshipping?

examples.chinese: 一大早就有不少民眾在寺廟前的廣場上運動。
examples.pinyin: Yī dàzǎo jiù yǒu bùshǎo mínzhòng zài sìmiào qián de guǎngchǎng shàng yùndòng.
examples.english: Early in the morning, quite a few people are already exercising in the square in front of the temple.

examples.chinese: 我花了大約兩萬塊錢學做法國菜，希望能夠快點兒學會。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huā le dàyuē liǎngwàn kuài qián xué zuò Fǎguó cài, xīwàng nénggòu kuài diǎnr xuéhuì.
examples.english: I spent about 20,000 dollars learning to cook French cuisine, hoping to be able to learn it quickly.

examples.chinese: 臺灣一般舊公寓的房子大約三十多坪，有客廳、廚房、一間浴室和三間臥房。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yìbān jiù gōngyù de fángzi dàyuē sānshí duō píng, yǒu kètīng, chúfáng, yì jiān yùshì hé sān jiān wòfáng.
examples.english: A typical old apartment in Taiwan is about thirty-something ping, with a living room, a kitchen, one bathroom, and three bedrooms.

examples.chinese: 珍珍每天大約看兩個小時的臺灣連續劇，目的是要(訓)練自己的中文聽力。大雄常利用週末練(習)書法，所以漢字寫得比其他同學都好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhēn měitiān dàyuē kàn liǎng ge xiǎoshí de Táiwān liánxùjù, mùdì shì yào xùnliàn zìjǐ de Zhōngwén tīnglì. Dàxióng cháng lìyòng zhōumò liànxí shūfǎ, suǒyǐ Hànzì xiě de bǐ qítā tóngxué dōu hǎokàn.
examples.english: Zhenzhen watches about two hours of Taiwanese TV dramas every day; her purpose is to train her Chinese listening comprehension. Daxiong often uses his weekends to practice calligraphy, so he writes Chinese characters more beautifully than any of his classmates.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 地球的表面大約百分之七十是水，百分之三十是地。
examples.pinyin: Dìqiú de biǎomiàn dàyuē bǎifēnzhī qīshí shì shuǐ, bǎifēnzhī sānshí shì dì.
examples.english: About seventy percent of the Earth's surface is water, and thirty percent is land.

examples.chinese: 搭飛機時，行李的重量是有限制的，大約一件25公斤。
examples.pinyin: Dā fēijī shí, xínglǐ de zhòngliàng shì yǒu xiànzhì de, dàyuē yī jiàn èrshíwǔ gōngjīn.
examples.english: When taking a plane, the weight of luggage is restricted, about 25 kilograms per piece.

examples.chinese: 這輛卡車有十二個輪子，大約能載二十五噸的物品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng kǎchē yǒu shí'èr ge lúnzi, dàyuē néng zài èrshíwǔ dūn de wùpǐn.
examples.english: This truck has twelve wheels and can carry about twenty-five tons of goods.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，目前已被發現的蝴蝶大約有三百七十種以上。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, mùqián yǐ bèi fāxiàn de húdié dàyuē yǒu sānbǎi qīshí zhǒng yǐshàng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, the butterflies that have been discovered so far number approximately over 370 species.

examples.chinese: 我家的客廳當中擺了一套皮沙發。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de kètīng dāngzhōng bǎi le yí tào pí shāfā.
examples.english: In the middle of my living room, a leather sofa set is placed.

examples.chinese: 五年前經驗過護照被偷的意外後，每次出國我都把護照放在上衣裡面的口袋。
examples.pinyin: Wǔ nián qián jīngyàn guò hùzhào bèi tōu de yìwài hòu, měi cì chūguó wǒ dōu bǎ hùzhào fàng zài shàngyī lǐmiàn de kǒudài.
examples.english: After experiencing the accident of having my passport stolen five years ago, every time I go abroad, I put my passport in the pocket inside my jacket.

examples.chinese: 你別把剛領的鈔票放在口袋裡，很容易不見的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié bǎ gāng lǐng de chāopiào fàng zài kǒudài lǐ, hěn róngyì bùjiàn de.
examples.english: Don't put the banknotes you just withdrew in your pocket; they can easily go missing.

items.wordHook: Combining 口(mouth) and 袋(bag): 口袋 means pockets.

examples.chinese: A: 現在的科技提供非常好用的網路服務，而且很多都是免費的。 B: 好用倒是好用，可是萬一沒有網路，就什麼都做不了了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài de kējì tígōng fēicháng hǎoyòng de wǎnglù fúwù, érqiě hěnduō dōu shì miǎnfèi de. B: Hǎoyòng dàoshì hǎoyòng, kěshì wànyī méiyǒu wǎnglù, jiù shénme dōu zuò bù liǎo le.
examples.english: A: Today's technology provides very easy-to-use internet services, and many are free. B: Sure, it's easy to use, but if there's no internet, then you can't do anything.

examples.chinese: 有人覺得留鬍子比較帥，我倒是覺得留了鬍子看起來比較老。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén juéde liú húzi bǐjiào shuài, wǒ dàoshì juéde liú le húzi kàn qǐlái bǐjiào lǎo.
examples.english: Some people think that having a beard looks more handsome, but I actually think that having a beard makes you look older.

examples.chinese: 章小姐接觸電影表演工作不久，雖然還是新人，對表演技巧倒是掌握得挺好的。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě jiēchù diànyǐng biǎoyǎn gōngzuò bùjiǔ, suīrán hái shì xīnrén, duì biǎoyǎn jìqiǎo dàoshì zhǎngwò de tǐng hǎo de.
examples.english: Miss Zhang has not been involved in film acting for long; although she is still a newcomer, she has actually mastered acting techniques quite well.

examples.chinese: 中國的古書雖然難懂，慢慢讀的話，我倒是多少能理解一些。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó de gǔshū suīrán nándǒng, mànman dú de huà, wǒ dàoshì duōshǎo néng lǐjiě yìxiē.
examples.english: Although ancient Chinese books are difficult to understand, if I read them slowly, I can more or less understand some of it.

examples.chinese: 我不太會跳高，跳遠倒是跳得還不錯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài huì tiàogāo, tiàoyuǎn dàoshì tiào de hái bùcuò.
examples.english: I am not very good at high jump, but as for long jump, I am actually not bad.

items.wordHook: Combining 倒(fall down) and 是(be): 倒是 means sure it is, but.

examples.chinese: 我記得第一次出國讀書時，因為不習慣和家人分開，常常半夜哭著打電話回家。那對情侶因為不了解而在一起，沒想到最後因為了解而分開。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde dì yī cì chūguó dúshū shí, yīnwèi bù xíguàn hé jiārén fēnkāi, chángcháng bànyè kūzhe dǎ diànhuà huí jiā. Nà duì qínglǚ yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér zài yīqǐ, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu yīnwèi liǎojiě ér fēnkāi.
examples.english: I remember when I first went abroad to study, because I wasn't used to being separated from my family, I often cried on the phone at midnight. That couple got together because they didn't understand each other, but unexpectedly in the end they separated because they understood each other.

examples.chinese: 新學期快要開始了。我們每天八點四十分開始上課。
examples.pinyin: Xīn xuéqī kuài yào kāishǐ le. Wǒmen měi tiān bā diǎn sìshí fēn kāishǐ shàngkè.
examples.english: The new semester is about to start. We start class at 8:40 every day.

examples.chinese: 林伯伯透過網路、報紙，尋找三十年前因為戰爭而分開的家人，最後終於找到了。
examples.pinyin: Lín bóbo tòuguò wǎnglù, bàozhǐ, xúnzhǎo sānshí nián qián yīnwèi zhànzhēng ér fēnkāi de jiārén, zuìhòu zhōngyú zhǎodào le.
examples.english: Uncle Lin searched through the Internet and newspapers for family members separated thirty years ago because of war, and finally found them.

examples.chinese: 這套書分上下兩冊，買書時不可分開購買。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào shū fēn shàng xià liǎng cè, mǎi shū shí bùkě fēnkāi gòumǎi.
examples.english: This set of books is divided into two volumes, upper and lower; when buying the books, they cannot be purchased separately.

examples.chinese: 所有令人傷腦筋的過程，都是為了使自己變成腦筋很好的人。
examples.pinyin: Suǒyǒu lìng rén shāng nǎojīn de guòchéng, dōu shì wèile shǐ zìjǐ biànchéng nǎojīn hěn hǎo de rén.
examples.english: All the brain-racking processes are for the purpose of making oneself a person with a good brain.

examples.chinese: A:哎呀！我的手機掉到河裡了。 （shock or annoyance）B:那真是傷腦筋，看來你只好再買一支了。
examples.pinyin: A: Āiyā! Wǒ de shǒujī diào dào hé lǐ le. B: Nà zhēn shì shāng nǎojīn, kànlái nǐ zhǐhǎo zài mǎi yī zhī le.
examples.english: A: Oh no! My cell phone fell into the river. B: That's really a headache; it seems you'll have to buy another one.

examples.chinese: 他說的話都很有道理，不是廢話，只是你聽不進去而已。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà dōu hěn yǒu dàolǐ, bù shì fèihuà, zhǐshì nǐ tīng bù jìnqù éryǐ.
examples.english: What he says is all very reasonable, not nonsense; it's just that you won't take it in.

examples.chinese: 這家醫院的內科有最新設備，因此成為許多病人的第一選擇。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de nèikē yǒu zuìxīn shèbèi, yīncǐ chéngwéi xǔduō bìngrén de dì yī xuǎnzé.
examples.english: This hospital's internal medicine department has the latest equipment, so it has become the first choice for many patients.

items.wordHook: Assessing overall 健(strong) vitality and 康(health) by conducting a 檢(check) and 查(investigate): 健康檢查 means physical check-up.
The 斤(axe) chops away the 欠(lack), so nothing is missing → 欣(delighted).
Combining 觀(observe) and 念(think of): 觀念 means concept.
